title: Electric Shock
description: Discover the surprising truth about EVs, inspired by India's EV Kranti movement. Watch for verifiable car insights and AI-generated visuals, then like and subscribe for more automotive news.

scenes.narration: Electric vehicles are changing the game
One key advantage is lower operating costs
With EVs, you can save up to 70 percent on fuel costs
But that's not all, EVs also require less maintenance
Fewer moving parts means less wear and tear
Make the switch to electric and experience the shock of savings
